title: IREP — Individual-Referential Evaluation Protocol (specification and reference repository)
description: A free, open, non-proprietary and not-for-sale protocol (available to commercial and non-commercial implementers alike) for hiring and admissions: category-blind, trajectory-rich evaluation first; category data flows only through a separate firewalled audit channel, analytically unavailable until decisions are finalized, for audit only. The individual is the reference class; the population is the audit instrument.
